mapper.select: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE username=#{username}
SELECT u.id,u.username,u.password_hash,u.real_name,u.dept_id,d.name dept_name,u.phone,u.email,u.enabled,u.auth_version FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id=u.dept_id WHERE u.id=#{id}
SELECT u.id,u.username,u.real_name,u.dept_id,d.name dept_name,u.enabled,u.auth_version FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id=u.dept_id WHERE u.id IN #{id} ORDER BY u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{id},id FROM app_role WHERE code=#{code}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM app_role WHERE code=#{code} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT r.code FROM app_role r JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.code
SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM app_permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id=p.id JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id=rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.code
